exposure_policy: any positive cumulative target with an immutable matching schedule

corpus_freeze.gate: immutable local manifests, source quality receipts, hashes, licence, document dedup, contamination and unseen-first evidence

cpt_gate.gate: summary complete, params and architecture immutable, valid/probe/natural-holdout/repeat gates pass; continuation, promotion and corpus reuse eligibility are independent

hard_rules.source_quality: all bound corpus quality receipts must pass before training starts
hard_rules.resume: weights, optimizer, sampler/cursor, run fingerprint and source closure must reconcile
hard_rules.oom: microbatch and accumulation may change only if effective batch and exposure remain invariant
hard_rules.promotion: continuation_checkpoint_eligible, automatic_parent_promotion_eligible and corpus_reuse_eligible are separate booleans
hard_rules.current: never mutate CURRENT.json without an explicit user freeze command
